metadata.title: Narrative Semantic Patterns
metadata.description: Reusable semantic patterns for story-first reasoning.

concepts.title: Story Arc
concepts.description: Overall story progression from setup to resolution.

concepts.title: Story Goal
concepts.description: The objective driving the story forward.

concepts.title: Story Conflict
concepts.description: The central pressure or opposition in the story.

concepts.title: Story Resolution
concepts.description: The ending phase that resolves or transforms the conflict.

concepts.title: Story Progression
concepts.description: The ordered movement of events across the narrative.

concepts.title: Scene Goal
concepts.description: The purpose of a scene at the local level.

concepts.title: Scene Transition
concepts.description: A shift between scenes, beats, or locations.

concepts.title: Character Arc
concepts.description: A character's evolution across the story.

concepts.title: Relationship Arc
concepts.description: The changing bond between characters over time.

concepts.title: Motivation Change
concepts.description: A shift in what a character wants or why they act.

concepts.title: Belief Change
concepts.description: A shift in what a character believes to be true.

concepts.title: Moral Change
concepts.description: A shift in a character's ethical stance.

concepts.title: Tone Shift
concepts.description: A noticeable change in emotional or stylistic tone.

concepts.title: Theme
concepts.description: The central idea or message of the story.

concepts.title: Subtext
concepts.description: Meaning implied beneath the literal wording.

concepts.title: Hidden Meaning
concepts.description: Meaning revealed by context rather than explicit wording.

concepts.title: Symbolism
concepts.description: Objects or actions that stand for deeper meaning.

concepts.title: Foreshadowing
concepts.description: An earlier clue that points toward a later event.

concepts.title: Callback
concepts.description: A later reference to an earlier detail.

concepts.title: Plot Twist
concepts.description: A surprising change that reinterprets previous events.

concepts.title: Red Herring
concepts.description: A misleading clue that pulls attention away from the real meaning.

concepts.title: Flashback
concepts.description: A return to an earlier event in time.

concepts.title: Flashforward
concepts.description: A preview of a later event or outcome.

concepts.title: Dream
concepts.description: A scene framed as a dream or dreamlike experience.

concepts.title: Hallucination
concepts.description: A scene framed as perception that may not be real.

concepts.title: Imaginary Sequence
concepts.description: A sequence that exists only in a character's mind.

concepts.title: Voice Over
concepts.description: Narration spoken over the visual scene.

concepts.title: Unreliable Narrator
concepts.description: A narrator whose account may not be trustworthy.

concepts.title: Parallel Story
concepts.description: A second story line that mirrors or contrasts the first.

concepts.title: Background Story
concepts.description: Events that happened before the current scene.

concepts.title: Scene Description
concepts.description: Visual or written description of what is happening.

concepts.title: Environmental Storytelling
concepts.description: Meaning conveyed through objects, space, or setting.

concepts.title: Off Screen Event
concepts.description: An event that happens outside the visible scene.

concepts.title: Implicit Event
concepts.description: An event inferred from context rather than directly shown.

concepts.title: Missing Information
concepts.description: A gap that prevents a full conclusion.

concepts.title: Time Skip
concepts.description: A jump forward or backward in time.

entries.title: Story Arc
entries.description: Narrative reasoning pattern for overall story progression from setup to resolution.
direct_expressions: story_arc is stated in the scene
false_positives: single sentence treated as full story meaning
character opinion treated as author opinion
counter_examples: A one-line comment with no story consequence.
A neutral description that is not part of a larger arc.
reviewer_guidance: Read the whole scene before deciding what the line means.
Ask whether later context changes the first impression.
Treat narrator, character, and viewer perspective separately.

confidence_modifiers.title: Story Arc corroborated
confidence_modifiers.description: Later scenes confirm the same narrative reading.

glossary_relationships.note: Narrative concepts usually reinforce each other.

gcam_mappings.note: Used for story-level reading and framing.

examples.title: Story Arc example
examples.text: A scene demonstrates story arc as part of the narrative flow.
examples.expected_outcome: Reviewer recognizes story arc and keeps the reading story-level.
examples.note: Story and scene should be read together.
